name: ferry
description: Move files one by one from a departure folder to an arrival folder.
author: Lucca Grillo

scripts.ship: npm run build && npm run install-app && open /Applications/Ferry.app

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Ferry needs access to move your files to or from the Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Ferry needs access to move your files to or from Documents.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Ferry needs access to move your files to or from Downloads.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Ferry needs access to move your files to or from external drives.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Ferry needs access to move your files to or from network drives.
